units.source_text: 今天上午不到十一点就进行了五手，这很难得。

en.t: This morning, five moves had already been played before eleven o'clock, which was very unusual.

units.source_text: 黑115终于到了胜败的关键，黑将侵削白的大模样，这时七段不会轻易落子。

en.t: Black 115 had finally reached the key point that would decide victory or defeat; Black would reduce White's large framework, and at this moment the seventh dan would not play lightly.
